etsy.title: ADHD Tax Receipt Poster, Funny Neurodivergent Wall Art, Sad Vegetables Print, ADHD Humor Gift for Adults
etsy.description:
A funny ADHD tax receipt poster that tallies up the hidden costs: late fees, forgotten trials, a second charger, and sad vegetables. Total: AGAIN.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a home office, by a desk, or wherever the bank account weeps.

This listing is a physical poster print, not a substitute for professional medical or therapy advice. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: ADHD tax is mostly stickers on Etsy; no physical posters found with this theme.
A mental health receipt printable exists (self-care themed, digital download) but is not about ADHD tax costs.
Receipt-style humor is a recognized format on Etsy (funny_receipt market page), but no one combines it with ADHD.
Amazon ADHD posters lean clinical (iceberg charts, therapy office decor); no receipt or cost-themed ADHD prints found.
Most Amazon ADHD wall art is 8x12 metal signs or unframed canvas prints.
